definitions.explanation: In Christianity, one of the twelve original followers of Jesus Christ sent to spread his teachings. Also used more broadly for a devoted follower or advocate of a cause or leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦キリスト→キリスト：24422_kirisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{十二|じゅうに}→十二：00952_juuni⟧{使徒|しと}。
{使徒|しと}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}めた→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧。
examples.english: The apostles spread the teachings throughout various regions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧な{使徒|しと}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a faithful disciple of that ideology.

notes:
Composed of {使|し} (to send; envoy) and {徒|と} (follower; companion). Literally "sent follower," reflecting the original meaning of the Greek "apostolos" (one who is sent).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{十二|じゅうに}→十二：00952_juuni⟧{使徒|しと}: the Twelve Apostles
- {使徒|しと}{行伝|ぎょうでん}: Acts of the Apostles (book of the Bible)
- ⟦キリスト→キリスト：24422_kirisuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使徒|しと}: apostle of Christ
- {使徒|しと}パウロ: the Apostle Paul

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word is also widely recognized in modern Japanese pop culture through the anime Neon Genesis Evangelion ({新世紀|しんせいき}エヴァンゲリオン), where the antagonistic beings are called {使徒|しと}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧: disciple; pupil — a general term for a follower or student of any teacher or master, not limited to religious contexts
- ⟦{信者|しんじゃ}→信者：11565_shinja⟧: believer; devotee — focuses on faith rather than the role of being sent to teach
- ⟦{宣教師|せんきょうし}→宣教師：12382_senkyoushi⟧: missionary — one who actively spreads religious teachings, a later role distinct from the original apostles
